reproduction: 55 synthetic reviewed stories. Tab34 times from the News bucket navigation opener to Show25more. Space reveals50 but keeps focus after the new stories. Another Space reveals55, removes the button and drops focus to body. The old label still claims25 for the final5.
implementation: Keep existing25-story batches. Capture the next story canonicalUrl/requestId only for a focus-visible keyboard-owned expansion.

Consume the handoff in a layout effect after commit; resolve the stable key within the committed history list. Require original trigger ownership or detached-trigger/body, focused visible document and no dialog/popover. No delayed RAF or generic helper.
Focus the first revealed story title without activation and scroll nearest. Pointer expansion does not arm the handoff. Label actual next batch count, including singular story.

pairedDecision.Steve: Supports local synchronous layout effect, stable key, keyboard-only handoff and correct final-batch count after challenge. Avoid async read-retry hook.
pairedDecision.Elena: Supports the same after challenge, with a preference for passing a matching button ref rather than a DOM data key. Actual data-key diff reviewed without actionable finding.
pairedDecision.Morgan: Scoped existing ul ref plus string dataset comparison avoids selector interpolation and another ReviewedRow prop. No shared hook or new dependency. Both reviewers agree on behavior; the ref/attribute preference is reversible.
